recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No current FHIR core source follow-up is indicated; any desire to patch the frozen STU3 website archive would need a separate publication/archive maintenance process outside this current source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-13263 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 correction for generated v3 CodeSystem and ValueSet HTML. The issue reported that generated ValueSet concept links used the FHIR CodeSystem id-plus-code fragment pattern even though the then-published v3 CodeSystem concept anchors used only the bare code, breaking links such as AcknowledgementDetailType code E.
initial_application: The Jira application note records SVN revision 12610. That revision is present in Git as 8234c93ab062a4a19632e5874bd2db979013b9fd, '#13263 - fix v3 cs anchors', and is an ancestor of both the worker branch and the combined branch. The patch changed ValueSetImporterV3 so generated v3 CodeSystem concept anchors include the v3 CodeSystem id prefix, matching generated ValueSet links.
additional_context: The frozen STU3 web page still shows the original mismatch, indicating that archive was not republished from the later tooling change. Current FHIR core no longer owns or generates those v3 terminology pages: source/fhir.ini has no active v3 CodeSystem or ValueSet entries, build.fhir.org returns 404 for the old v3/AcknowledgementDetailType paths, and 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 deleted ValueSetImporterV3 while removing UTG content from the core build. Current THO pages for AcknowledgementDetailType have matching links and anchors.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the Jira's recorded application commit is already in current history and there is no active current FHIR core source location whose edit would change the old v3/AcknowledgementDetailType page.
